Z-Image – 简单的文本到图像工作流程（带有可选的 LoRA 支持）

此工作流程旨在干净、简单且非常易于使用同时仍然为您提供生成高质量 Z 图像所需的一切。布局组织得非常清晰，你可以一目了然地看到整个过程——提示→设置→生成。没有杂乱，没有在画布上徘徊。

它还包括一个可选 LoRA 加载器为了字符一致性或风格变化，以及内置1K 和 2K 宽高比参考表这样您就可以快速输入所需的精确分辨率，而无需寻找数字。

Z-Image 针对分辨率进行了优化高达2K。任何更高的值都会变得柔和，因此工作流程包括推荐的 2K 和 1K 尺寸的完整列表，以便于复制。

在 RTX 4090 (24GB VRAM) 上，它的执行速度非常快：
• 1K 图像：通常30秒以内
• 2K 图像：通常1分钟以内

如果您想要一个干净、简洁的 Z 图像设置，并且所有内容都清晰紧凑地布局，那么此工作流程可以使生成变得简单、可预测且快速。


工作流程要求

  1. zImage_turbo.safetensors
    保存到：ComfyUI\models\diffusion_models

  2. zImage_vae.safetensors
    保存到：ComfyUI\models\vae

  3. zImage_textEncoder.safetensors
    保存到：ComfyUI\models\text_encoders

下载链接：
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/tree/main/split_files

注意：
如果 ComfyUI 显示缺少节点，请打开 ComfyUI 管理器并单击“安装缺少的自定义节点”。

o.en:
Z-Image – Easy Text-to-Image Workflow (With optional LoRA support)

This workflow is built to beclean, simple, and extremely easy to usewhile still giving you everything you need for high-quality Z-Image generations. The layout is organized so clearly that you can see the entire process at a glance — prompt → settings → generate. No clutter, no wandering around the canvas.

It also includes anoptional LoRA loaderfor character consistency or style variations, along with a built-in1K and 2K aspect-ratio reference sheetso you can quickly type in the exact resolution you want without hunting for numbers.

Z-Image is optimized for resolutionsup to 2K. Anything higher tends to soften, so the workflow includes a full list of recommended 2K and 1K sizes for easy copy-over.

On an RTX 4090 (24GB VRAM), it performs extremely fast:
• 1K images:typicallyunder 30 seconds
• 2K images:usuallyunder 1 minute

If you want a clean, no-nonsense Z-Image setup that has everything laid out clearly and compactly, this workflow keeps generation simple, predictable, and fast.


Workflow Requirements

  1. zImage_turbo.safetensors
    Save to: ComfyUI\models\diffusion_models

  2. zImage_vae.safetensors
    Save to: ComfyUI\models\vae

  3. zImage_textEncoder.safetensors
    Save to: ComfyUI\models\text_encoders

Download link:
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/tree/main/split_files

Note:
If ComfyUI shows missing nodes, open the ComfyUI Manager and click “Install Missing Custom Nodes.”
